target.label: yt.flow system-level pre-release trace (Epics 1-4, all stories done)

rationale: P0 coverage is 100% (6/6). P1 coverage is 100% (8/8, exceeds the 90% PASS target). Overall coverage is 80% (exactly meets minimum). Remediation during this trace closed 4 real gaps (SYS-INT-004/007/008/009) and, while building SYS-E2E-001, found and fixed a critical production bug: pipeline/nodes/__init__.py wired Story 1.4 stub functions instead of the real (already-implemented, already-unit-tested) scenario/image/tts/subtitle nodes, meaning every real run would have produced zero scenes and failed at the video stage. Also fixed a GET /runs/{id}/artifact filename mismatch (output.mp4 vs the actual video.mp4) that 404'd every video download. The one remaining uncovered item, SYS-INT-012 (P2, Alembic migration roundtrip), is a structural non-gap — no Alembic tooling exists in the codebase to test — and is excluded from the P0/P1 gate criteria by design.
